title: Armory Requirements and Effects Vocabulary
extensionPolicy: This vocabulary describes declarations shipped with Ran. Custom Armory content may use additional names, but unknown requirements do not gate applicability and unknown effects have no built-in semantics unless an external parser handles them.

interpolation.description: Before effects are processed, Ran substitutes execution arguments into every effect string. Argument lookup is ASCII case-insensitive. Interpolation is a property of all effect declarations, not selected effect kinds.

supportLevels.description: The requirement participates in applicability evaluation.
The effect has a built-in output parser.
The effect directly changes campaign facts or graph structure.
The effect is confirmed through a runtime event rather than stdout.
Only the documented syntax variants have built-in semantics.
The declaration does not gate applicability or produce campaign facts. It may still be classified for scoring.

requirements.name: kind
requirements.matching: A string or any string array member matches the selected entity kind case-insensitively. System also matches any system entity.

requirements.name: rbacPermissions
requirements.matching: One captured or active Kubernetes identity must satisfy every listed permission. An empty array passes.
requirements.description: Requires Kubernetes RBAC permissions. The rbac YAML spelling is normalized before API serialization.

requirements.name: accessLevel
requirements.matching: none passes. Any other string requires executable access, except for exempt tactics.
requirements.description: Requires execution access to a system target.

requirements.name: activeSession
requirements.matching: true requires an active session on the selected target. false imposes no restriction.

requirements.name: filesystemAccess
requirements.matching: true requires direct filesystem execution access or an executable same-node Pod with a hostPath. false imposes no restriction.
requirements.description: Requires a realizable path to the target filesystem.

requirements.name: has-token
requirements.matching: true requires a non-empty token on the selected target. false imposes no restriction.

requirements.name: exists
requirements.matching: Every entry must match an existing entity. Entries may be kind strings or objects with kind and optional exact name and namespace fields.

requirements.name: related
requirements.matching: Every recognized target-kind and related-kind pair must be satisfied. Unknown relationship combinations pass.
requirements.description: Requires entities related to the selected target.

requirements.name: c2.has-listener
requirements.matching: The presence of any listener must equal the declared boolean.
requirements.description: Requires or forbids a registered C2 listener.

requirements.name: c2.has-session
requirements.matching: The selected C2 must own a live, unbroken session exactly when true is declared.
requirements.description: Requires or forbids a live C2 session.

requirements.name: c2.has-tool
requirements.matching: Every named executable must resolve on the operator host. Invalid array members are ignored.

requirements.name: Pod.securityContext.privileged
requirements.matching: Known opposite evidence blocks the action. Unknown security context passes.
requirements.description: Matches the selected Pod privileged state.

requirements.name: Pod.securityContext.hostPID
requirements.matching: Known opposite evidence blocks the action. Unknown security context passes.
requirements.description: Matches the selected Pod host PID state.

requirements.name: Pod.hostPath
requirements.matching: A boolean requires or forbids any hostPath. A string requires one exact normalized source path. An array requires every listed source path.
requirements.description: Requires hostPath exposure on the selected Pod.

requirements.name: linuxNamespaceAccess
requirements.matching: Unknown access passes. The latest matching action evidence blocks a namespace after a recognized denial and restores it after success.
requirements.description: Requires access to named Linux namespaces.

requirements.name: sys.has-binary
requirements.matching: No applicability predicate currently reads this requirement.
requirements.description: Legacy declaration of a target-side binary dependency. Procedures should declare their tool instead.

requirements.name: Container.securityContext.capabilities
requirements.matching: No applicability predicate currently reads this requirement.

requirements.name: pkg:golang/k8s.io/ingress-nginx
requirements.matching: No applicability predicate currently reads this package-specific requirement.
